{{Quote|My shuttle's prepped. Hop aboard, and we'll be on our way.|Uptin|<ref name="Trouble in Paradise" />}}
'''Uptin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] navigator who served in the [[Avesta Militia]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3638 BBY]], Uptin was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] when the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] began to block all of Makeb's comm channels, preventing him from contacting his family. After meeting a Republic strike team, Uptin took them down to the planet to put an end to the Hutt's control.

==Biography==
Born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] some time after [[3681 BBY]], Uptin worked as a [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3638 BBY]], Uptin was stationed on [[Keylander Station]]&mdash;in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Makeb&mdash;when the forces of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] [[Conquest of Makeb|invaded]] his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Trouble in Paradise" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Everything we built, just&hellip; crumbling away. And for what, credits?|Uptin|<ref name="Trouble in Paradise" />}}
Uptin was [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] with [[Color/Legends|blond]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], yellow eyes and light skin. He cared deeply for his world, feeling frustrated for what the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] had done to his people and wishing Makeb had joined the Republic earlier. Uptin spoke [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'leki]].<ref name="Trouble in Paradise" />

==Behind the scenes==
Uptin appears in the [[2013]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']] to the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He is featured within the Republic storyline in several quests, including "Trouble in Paradise".<ref name="Trouble in Paradise" />
